SRC-309:R001.text: E10/E11 prevention: a canonical phase transition must not carry a stale STATE.blocker into the next phase -- measured, transition SHIP->BUILD succeeded with blocker 'operator_required (continuation_authority) for REVIEW -> SHIP' still set, and transition BLOCKED->SCOUT left the same blocker in place, so binding_brake then refuses every consequential verb on a project that just transitioned legally. A transition that leaves BLOCKED must clear the phase's own blocker, and a transition that enters an ACTIVE phase from an active phase must not preserve a blocker that no canonical verb authored.
